{{Otheruses|Coruscant Museum}}
The '''Coruscant Museum''' was a [[Museum/Legends|museum]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After the [[Corellian Crisis|First Corellian Insurrection]], a new wing devoted to the conflict was opened. It was dedicated to those who had fallen in the battle.
